mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.5%, it signals a dovish monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) indicates a successful monetary policy easing that reduces both the cost of capital and inflation fears, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS falling and CPIAUCSL falling) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economy with unemployment below 3.5% and rising, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and UNRATE rising > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and rising > 0.1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth, as measured by the change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), signals sustained economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS growth and 20-day SPX returns is negative or insignificant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1,200,000 units per month indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in both the housing and consumer sectors, signaling an imminent economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST falling and RSAFS falling) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing sector where industrial production growth is decelerating by more than 0.5% over the past three months, the market anticipates a slowdown in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate decelerating > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate decelerates > 0.5% in 3 months.
